Not really much of a review, more initial impressions as I’m all kinds of sick today (some kind a nasty flu like crap) and not really feeling like vaping.

So far it hasn’t exploded/caught fire/vented/kicked my dog etc, but I’ll be keeping an eye on it and after I run it for a bit to ensure I don’t need to send it back for the non explody issues reported with the black IPV4s it will probably lose its balance board.

In terms of feel it doesn’t feel like a POS but doesn’t scream high end either. The battery door’s tight and doesn’t rattle, buttons are nice, and the screens nice and bright. Biggest part of the “not high end” feel is the stamped construction of the body of the mod, somewhere between an altoids tin and an AK-47 mag. Overall, it’s something that has the potential to be a pretty decent mod if the manufacturer squares away the QC issues. It’s really unfortunate they got sloppy trying to push this out.
